fixes: Pyroar Flare Command pays from its own slot on the Bench or Active, accepts attached Fire-providing Energy, and rejects missing costs or targets before payment
XY Venipede uses its printed 70 HP, 20 Poison Sting damage and three-Energy retreat, independently of the BW source constructor
Delta Evolution permission belongs only to the actual trait evolution card being played from hand, not unrelated copies on either field or in hand
Dry Skin queries the current attacker type and respects damage that ignores defender effects
Light of Life recognizes both Yveltal and Yveltal-EX through shared named-condition parsing, including BW copied attacks
Cross Slicer and Time Freeze use attack-effect events, respecting protection and normal switch/turn cleanup
Burning Energy records actual eligible discards before native reducers move cards and returns to the same in-play Pokemon, with negative controls for other attackers and Trainers
A shared attached-Energy view covers regular attachments and Pokemon-as-Energy zones for Enhanced Hammer, Shuppet, Xerosic, Jirachi, Groudon-EX and Dragonite-EX
Energy discards route through attack prevention and the correct physical zone; Xerosic puts each card in its owner discard pile
Stardust grants its shield only after a successful discard from the opponent Active; Bench-only Special Energy and blocked discards do not grant it

Dragonite-EX, Greninja and Pyroar native attack indexes match their printing; Mist Slash uses the normal damage/KO pipeline with correct bypass flags and attacker bonuses; Inferno Onrush applies recoil
Hyper Beam, Rip Claw and Stardust resolve defensive-Energy discards after damage, so Shield Energy still reduces that attack
